title: Multi-mode soil chemical passivation and crop protection of severe cadmium and arsenic polluted soils with engineered silica
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00055F, Paper

Jiawei Yang, Paul N. Williams, Xiaoxia Cao, Jun Luo, Hongyan Liu, Yingjian Xu
Functionalized mesoporous silica is a multi-mode chemical passivation technology, offering a novel and integrated solution for complex agricultural issues in severely As and Cd contaminated soils.
